figures.caption: Figure 4: Standard Token Budget Experiment. Performance of MOGA on GPT-2 small model and LLaMA-130M model compared to Muon and AdamW with 1×chinchilla optimal token budget.
Figure 5: Large Token Budget Experiment. Performance of MOGA on GPT-2 small model and LLaMA-130M model compared to Muon and AdamW. MOGA exhibits a faster convergence speed in the low-loss stage.
Figure 2: Embedding layer geometry. One-hot inputs place embedding training in the 1→ (𝑞,mean) geometry, where both column normalization and SignGD are effective.

Figure 1: Operators Should Play Nice Together. Chaining layer-wise stability bounds under ∥ · ∥ 𝑝→𝑞 requires ∥ · ∥ 𝑝 ≤ ∥ · ∥𝑞 . This fails for classical 𝑝 → 𝑞 norms when 𝑝 ≤ 𝑞 but holds for (𝑝,mean) → (𝑞,mean) norms, yielding dimension-independent bounds.
Figure 3: Learning Rate Transfer. Performance of MOGA from GPT-2 Small to GPT-XL. The optimal learning rate of MOGA is invariant to width.
